title: Treasury monitor (plain TypeScript)
summary: Reads the native and ERC-20 balances of a public address list on Base through the Sato Kit's chain.read, reports each in exact base units and exact native units with a valuation only where a named price was supplied, and fires a threshold alert once per crossing. Fixture mode needs no network and no key. It holds no key, signs nothing and moves no funds in any mode.

tests.description: The platform runs the fixture command over the shipped RPC recordings (no network, no key) and checks out/report.json against schemas/output.json: exit 0, exact balances at the recorded block, an unpriced holding left null, and the threshold alert fired once.
The template's own tests. Recorded, never the verdict.

Nightly in satohubai/sato-agent-templates: an anvil fork of Base at block 51800000; exact native and USDC balances through the kit's chain.read, and one monitor pass whose alert fires once and stays quiet on resume. Holds no key.

Weekly in satohubai/sato-agent-templates: against the public Base Sepolia RPC with no key, chain reads through the kit checked on contract constants and answer shapes (never on moving balances), plus this template's testnet answers. Never signs, never broadcasts.

provenance.notes: Deterministic over fixtures. Fork and rpc modes are opt-in and never run in the platform's offline test phase.
